From d6a57588666301acd9d42d3b00d74240964f07f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2023 08:38:15 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu: disable MCBP by default

Disable MCBP(mid command buffer preemption) by default as old Mesa
hangs with it. We shall not enable the feature that breaks old usermode
driver.

Fixes: 50a7c8765ca6 ("drm/amdgpu: enable mcbp by default on gfx9")
Signed-off-by: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Acked-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
index 5c0817cbc7c2..1cc1ae2743c1 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
@@ -3791,10 +3791,6 @@ static void amdgpu_device_set_mcbp(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 	else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
-	else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
-		 (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
-		 adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
-		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev))
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c`**
   - The code block that previously enabled mid command buffer preemption (MCBP) for certain GPU versions (specifically between IP versions 9.0.0 and 10.0.0) has been removed. 
   - The logic now only sets `adev->gfx.mcbp` to `true` if `amdgpu_mcbp` is explicitly set to a non-zero value or if the device is a SR-IOV virtual function. 
   - This change effectively disables MCBP by default, addressing compatibility issues with older Mesa drivers.

### Relationships

- The modification in `amdgpu_device.c` directly addresses the issue of MCBP compatibility with older user-mode drivers, as noted in the patch description. 
- The removal of the conditional enabling of MCBP for specific GPU versions is a response to the identified problem that enabling this feature causes hangs in older Mesa versions. 
- The patch is a corrective action to a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag) that enabled MCBP by default on gfx9, indicating a regression that needed to be resolved.

Here is the commit message:
drm/amdgpu: disable MCBP by default

Disable MCBP(mid command buffer preemption) by default as old Mesa
hangs with it. We shall not enable the feature that breaks old usermode
driver.

Fixes: 50a7c8765ca6 ("drm/amdgpu: enable mcbp by default on gfx9")
Signed-off-by: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Acked-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the enabling of mid command buffer preemption (MCBP) by default on certain GPU architectures (specifically gfx9), which leads to compatibility issues and hangs in older Mesa drivers that do not support this feature. The logic that conditionally enabled MCBP for specific GPU versions was removed to prevent these issues.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void amdgpu_device_set_mcbp(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 {
 	if (amdgpu_mcbp == 1)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 	else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
-	else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
-		 (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
-		 adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
-		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev))
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (adev->gfx.mcbp)
 		DRM_INFO("MCBP is enabled\n");
 }

```c
else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
         (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
         adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
```
Reason:
This code conditionally enables mid command buffer preemption (MCBP) for specific GPU architectures (gfx9) without checking for compatibility with older Mesa drivers. This can lead to hangs in those drivers when MCBP is enabled by default.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (amdgpu_mcbp == 1)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
```
Reason:
These statements set MCBP based on the `amdgpu_mcbp` variable, which is explicitly controlled, thus disabling MCBP by default and preventing the compatibility issues with older Mesa drivers.
